dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave parabolic spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior insertion point to the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a wide pixel radius at the peak morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Non-linear convex slope, measuring approximately 35-45 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base-to-vertical height ratio of approximately 1.7:1.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-frequency specular reflections (water droplets) distributed across the dorsal surface anterior to the fin insertion.
